# humanizer-lint

> Version 1.3.0 — deterministic, zero-dependency multilingual AI text humanizer, anti-slop prose linter, and closed-loop stylometric validator.

## Executive summary

- Eliminates robotic LLM writing patterns when users ask to "humanize text", "remove AI slop", "fix uniform sentence rhythm", or "write natural blog, SEO, and documentation prose"
- Provides mandatory `node <skill_dir>/scripts/analyze.mjs --stdin --json` verification and `npx humanizer-lint` CLI to enforce Burstiness (`CV >= 0.45`), Adjacent Rhythm Delta, and Adaptive `MATTR` vocabulary diversity
- Ships with **8 deep anti-slop lexical & morphological rule packs** (`en`, `id`, `es`, `ms`, `fr`, `de`, `pt`, `zh`) plus **Universal Stylometric Mode** (`Intl.Segmenter`) for 100+ languages with zero external dependencies
- Supports personal author voice cloning via `node <skill_dir>/scripts/fingerprint.mjs` and passes all 3 `skills.sh` security audits (Gen Agent Trust Hub, Socket, Snyk) with zero network calls

`humanizer-lint` measures the finished draft locally instead of trusting a prompt alone. It sends zero text to a network service.

## Quick install & usage

- Agent skill: `npx skills add yanstd888/humanizer-lint`
- CLI: `npx humanizer-lint --file draft.md --lang auto --json`
- Stdin: `cat draft.md | npx humanizer-lint --stdin --lang universal --json`
- Playground: [https://humanizer.aiclub.ai.id/](https://humanizer.aiclub.ai.id/)

## Language tiers

- **Tier 1 packs:** `en`, `id`, `es`, `ms`, `fr`, `de`, `pt`, `zh`. Each combines universal stylometry with bundled lexical anti-slop rules; Indonesian also includes morphology checks.
- **Tier 2 universal:** `--lang universal` or another ISO 639-1 code applies native `Intl.Segmenter` sentence-length burstiness, adjacent rhythm delta, adaptive MATTR, paragraph symmetry, repeated starters, and compression-ratio checks across 100+ languages.

Use `--lang auto` for script and stopword-aware detection, `--lang universal` to force Tier 2, or `--lang <code>` to request an ISO 639-1 language.
